content:
For \(5 \le n \le 13\), the square-sum graph is disconnected, so no valid sequence exists.  
For \(n=14\), vertices \(8,9,10\) all have degree \(1\), but a Hamiltonian path can have only two endpoints, so impossible.

For \(n=15\), the sequence
\[
8,1,15,10,6,3,13,12,4,5,11,14,2,7,9
\]
has adjacent sums
\[
9,16,25,16,9,16,25,16,9,16,25,16,9,16,
\]
all perfect squares.

Thus the smallest value is \(\boxed{15}\).
